# BackendManager

> **File:** `services/core/BackendManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The shell's connection to the axiom binary, its parent (`axiom run`, docs/dev/backend/README.md): JSON-RPC over the socket the binary names in $AXIOM_SOCKET. It says hello (the protocol and the schema read), relays what the binary pushes (notified), sends calls (queued until the hello is answered) and answers the binary's own calls (handle). It reconnects when the binary re-execs. Below every other service: it reads the environment only, so ConfigManager can stand on it. Started without $AXIOM_SOCKET (the shell run by hand, not by axiom), it stays inactive.

### Properties

- `socketPath` (readonly string)
- `active` (readonly bool)
- `ready` (readonly bool): Connected and greeted: calls go out at once
- `hello` (readonly var): The binary's daemon.hello answer ({ protocol, version, schemaHash, state, dirs, compatible, reason, … }), null until it came
- `incompatible` (readonly string): Set by the binary when it was built for other shell files: config stays read-only and a notice says why (shell.qml).
- `compatible` (readonly bool): Whether axiom takes config writes now (it follows dev mode)
- `dev` (readonly var): Dev mode as axiom has it ({ enabled, available, unavailable, building, lastBuild: { ok, at, output }, binary, installed }): DevManager switches it

### Signals

- `greeted()`: A hello was answered (after the first connect and every reconnect)

### Functions

- `listen(method, fn)`: Calls fn(params) whenever the binary pushes method (config.changed, config.state, schema.changed, …).
- `call(method, params, done)`: Calls method; done(error, result) with error null or { kind, message, issues }.
- `notify(method, params)`: Sends a notification (no reply)
- `acquire(topic, request)`: Subscribes to a polled topic ({ interval } in ms, plus what the topic's own request carries): axiom fetches it at the shortest interval anyone asked and pushes `<topic>.state` when it changes.
- `release(topic)`: Drops the subscription: with nobody else subscribed, axiom stops fetching
- `refresh(topic)`: Asks axiom to fetch an acquired topic now
- `handle(method, fn)`: Answers the binary's calls of method with fn(params): a result, or a thrown { kind, message }
- `addTarget(target)`: IpcTarget's registration: the names go to axiom (which reads their functions from `qs ipc show`), calls come back as ipc.call
- `removeTarget(target)`
- `targetsChanged()`
